About

A community of business graduates and business leaders from across Pakistan.

Who we are

Business Gap brings together business graduates, professionals, and institutes from every part of Pakistan. We believe that the right network can close the gap between education and real business.

Our members come from different cities, industries, and stages of their careers, but share one goal: to learn from each other and grow together.

Our mission

To connect Pakistan's business graduates and leaders and help them grow through shared knowledge and opportunity.

Our vision

A strong, connected business community across the whole country.

What members get

Connect with peers
Meet business graduates and business leaders from across Pakistan.
Learn from experience
Hear from people who have built, run, and grown real businesses.
Find opportunities
Discover partnerships, mentors, and openings through the network.

Become part of a network of business graduates and leaders from across Pakistan.
